notes.title: Check out the Major Update!
notes.content:
Hi Juxtians! 

A new major update/patch is HERE! The team is addressing many of the issues the community has shared with us and has made over 40 improvements and bug fixes in this major update. 

We made quality of life fixes that ease some of the unnecessary pain points identified by early players at launch, while still keeping the difficulty up and addressing some overpowered builds. Based on your comments and feedback, we’ve made several improvements to make a more balanced gameplay experience. Please check out the Patch Notes [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1428710/view/5466829825401486441]here[/url][/b].

Please keep playing and sharing your thoughts! This community means everything to us. 

Thanks,
Actual Nerds & Mastiff

notes.title: New Update: #1.1
notes.content:
Hi Juxtians! 

We’re pleased to announce that we’ve pushed through a new major update with over 40 improvements and bug fixes. Here are some of the changes:

[b]Improvements:[/b]
• Roll, Dashing, and Backstep improvements: 
-  Speed, iframes, and length have been increased for all three.

• Enemy staggering: 
-  Enemy staggers now last longer.

• Weapon Upgrade System Improvements:
- Flake and Bar item drop rate increased.
- Additional upgrade materials will be added to the Merchant’s store after the player defeats each of the following bosses: Rotting King, Sister of Reverence, Beloved and Defender, Specklord Tyris, and Lorentino bosses.

• Reworked Stamina System:
- Stamina cost increase for Roll, Dash, and Backstep.
- Overall Stamina regeneration decreased.
- Stamina regeneration removed during the beginning of attacks.
- Energy Rush Stamina regeneration reduction.

• Weapon Balancing:
- Fist weapons no longer scale with Vitality and Stamina.
- Spear attacks cost more stamina. Spear attacks deal more toughness damage.
- Greatsword and Warhammer damage increase for charged attacks.
- Greatsword and Warhammer input registration improvements. Additionally, players can cancel charge attacks early, which will change into a standard attack.

• Quality of Life Fixes:
- Player turn animation removed
- Cutscene skips added to the following Bosses after the first attempt: Apathia elevator fight, Apathia final fight, and Seer and Manipulator.
- Silver Speckcraft Knight magic pillars damage nerf.
- Various music levels increased.
- Player death count reset on New Game Plus.
- Siege Tunnels room near the middle has had decoration improvements to make traps more obvious.

• Boss Balancing:
- Conquerors overall health reduced. Third conqueror now spawns less minions.
- Specklord Tyris Laser attack feedback improved.
- Drelium health reduced in Phase 1. Health increased in Phase 2.
- Seer and Manipulator attack probability improvements. Arena door glow added to left side.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
• Attempting to activate the Seer and Manipulator relic will no longer crash the game
• Specklord Tyris projectiles no longer crash game on hit.
• Unspeakable Queen relic is no longer usable on Bosses.
• The end of an attack animation no longer disregards input for queuing the next attack.
• Valley of Juxtia map no longer shows a room entrance to a non-existent room.
• Wraith Legion can no longer clip outside the map, resulting in an instant boss kill.
• Room in Verdant Gardens near the middle no longer has frozen waterfalls.
• Saved games will now keep track of acquired duplicate armor pieces.
• Darkest Heart warp gate is no longer accessible from the top of the map.
• Room in War Wastes with Mortorbs near the left entrance will no longer attack the player when they are near that entrance.
• During boss battles, if the player kills a boss, the player will no longer be killable during cinematics.
• If the boss kills a player, the boss will no longer be killable during cinematics.
• Verdant Gardens entrance room will no longer allow the player to teleport through the shortcut wall.
• Palace of Secrets entrance room will no longer have a decoration on the wrong layer.
• Returning to Tralium's arena will no longer lock the player.
• For the duration of the fight, the portal in Drelium's arena will no longer remain open if the player chooses to fight Drelium.
• Attempting to activate the Seer and Manipulator relic will no longer crash the game.
• In certain rooms the camera will no longer suddenly drop when exiting a room.
• Verdant Garden Seers will no longer lose sight of the player if there is a small height difference between them.
• Herald's relic will no longer cause animation stutters on enemies without toughness meters.
• Certain keyboard functions no longer trigger debug effects.

If you encounter any other bugs or issues, please let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1428710/discussions/]Discussions[/url] – and on [url=https://www.facebook.com/ttojgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ttojgame]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/tarnishingofjuxtia/]Instagram[/url]!

Thanks,
Actual Nerds & Mastiff

notes.title: Bugfixes - July 28th
notes.content:
Hello!

We love how vocal our community has been and really appreciate all the feedback.
As we continue to work on improvements and balance, we have rolled out some new bugfixes.

The following have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Using a ladder would lock the player until they restarted the game.
[*] Killing the Unspeakable Queen boss would not generate a Steam Achievement.
[*] Steam screenshot (f12 by default) fixed.
[*] Artisan or Merchant talk menus would stay on screen after being closed.
[*] Rotting King boss could get stuck at the edge of its arena.
[*] Valley of Juxtia map had a room entrance in a misleading location.
[*] The Crown map had a room entrance in a misleading location.
[/list]
